multiplechoiceresponse.p: An entire company cannot reach email. Which priority is appropriate?

div.p: Priority combines urgency and impact. A company-wide outage of a core service is P1 and becomes the top of the queue.

choice.div: "Outlook fails to open with error 0x8004010F after this morning's update; reproduced twice"

div.p: A good ticket names the symptom, the affected system, and the evidence. A vague summary forces the next technician to start from zero.

choice.div: How soon a human first replies to the user.
How long until the issue is fully fixed.
The total number of tickets closed.

div.p: Response time is time to first reply; resolution time is time to a fix. Knowing the difference prevents over-promising to users.
